description: English meeting with three clearly-named participants (Marko, Jelena, James). Tests legitimate name use and that 'Atila' (from the production prompt example) does not bleed into outputs even when other names are present.

segments.text: Alright everyone, thanks for joining. Marko, Jelena, James — let's go through the launch checklist.
Sure. So Marko, you were going to handle the database migration script. Where are we on that?
I have got the migration ready. I will run it against staging tomorrow morning and send the diff to the channel.
Great. Jelena, can you take the customer-facing announcement? We need a draft by Wednesday.
Yes, I will have a draft ready by Tuesday end of day so we have a buffer.
Perfect. James, you are on the rollback plan, right? Make sure ops sign off before Friday.
Yep, I will get sign-off by Thursday. I have already sent the draft to the ops lead.
Good. We agreed in the last sync we are launching Friday at 2pm — confirming that is still the plan.
